scope: GDT877 raw-construction outcome treated as structural, not semantic

rival_logic.original_contrast: Head-conditioned axis says the same written value slot changes domain with X; fixed-ordinal rival says the value is invariant and X is ordinary content.
rival_logic.compatibility_problem: These are not mutually exclusive. An invariant numeral III can occur in different grade, material, nominal, or stage domains, while X still conditions the domain. Conversely, a fixed ordinal can coexist with local field syntax. Observing multiple X-daiin constructions or raw continuity does not choose the rivals.
rival_logic.specific_countermodel: Every five construction keeps value III as an invariant ordinal; each X independently selects a different ordinary lexical/domain field. This reproduces the observed X changes while rejecting the proposed claim that the value interpretation itself changes.
rival_logic.877_limit: GDT877’s 4/5 all-three literal/clear result and one annotated ZL raw group (no native gap adjudication) can establish anchor eligibility only. It cannot establish III, grade/amount/stage, or any X semantic class.

review.missing_design: The proposal lacks an explicit distinction between invariant value identity and changing domain assignment; its falsifier only says “value remains invariant” without defining a source-independent value endpoint or domain endpoint.
review.missing_binding: Independent bindings for (a) the written-value identity/domain of III and (b) the X field domain are required before a semantic rival test can be predeclared. Raw whole-form continuity is insufficient.
review.changed_contract: One possible future restriction would predeclare two models that differ on value-versus-domain: Model A keeps III invariant while X changes only field domain; Model B predicts X-dependent value interpretation. This is a proposed contract distinction, not an established meaning and not a silent reinterpretation of the original head-axis claim. Any use would still require independently coded domain endpoints and an outcome that can assign one model without assuming the gloss.
review.decision_consequence: A 877 pass changes only whether the five constructions may serve as all-three raw structural anchors; it leaves IDEA000087 unresolved. A 877 failure would fail the all-three literal-anchor status for the affected triple, while eligible IT/RF evidence remains retained; it still would not falsify either semantic rival.
